contradictions: Current QB stability is materially better than 2025 disruption, but the historical TMF constraint remains relevant until sustained through a longer operating window.
Three stable quarters support recovery, but the company explicitly warned in 2025 that TMF and recovery execution could impair 2026-27 output; both facts should remain live.
Improved Q2 production/costs coexist with a recent history of material QB execution failure; neither observation cancels the other.

Current stable QB operations strengthen the recovery thesis, while the 2025 reset proves the same operating chain has recently failed; this is a live resilience test rather than evidence that either observation is false.
